skill.name: appflowy-api
skill.description: Use AppFlowy Cloud and GoTrue APIs to authenticate, inspect workspaces, search content, and automate page, block, and grid updates.
skill.summary: Automate authenticated AppFlowy API workflows for workspaces, pages, blocks, search, and grid data.
skill.author: BaloneGit

security_audit.summary: I confirmed intended AppFlowy network capability and hardcoded private HTTP examples that could receive copied credentials or bearer tokens. I dismissed the remaining static alerts as Markdown code fences, whitelisted helper execution, stdin reads, map keys, or opt-in configuration handling. No prompt injection or hidden exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Hardcoded private HTTP endpoint appears in examples and config.
remediation.suggestion: Replace 10.60.0.189 examples with placeholders, and recommend HTTPS or user-supplied local endpoints.

remediation.issue: Credential and token workflows can expose secrets in shell history or logs.
remediation.suggestion: Document safer token handling, avoid logging tokens, and recommend short-lived or least-privilege credentials.

remediation.issue: Grid and document update scripts can modify or remove AppFlowy content.
remediation.suggestion: Add dry-run or confirmation modes for destructive updates and recommend backups before production use.

content.value_statement: AppFlowy API work often requires repeated setup, token handling, and nested document operations. This skill provides scripts and references for authenticated AppFlowy automation.
actual_capabilities: Authenticates with GoTrue using email and password to obtain access tokens.
Builds AppFlowy clients from CLI arguments, JSON config, selected environment variables, or an opt-in .env path.
Lists workspaces, databases, row IDs, and row details through AppFlowy API endpoints.
Creates page views, appends blocks, adds database fields, upserts rows, and updates page names.
Applies grid templates and updates select options through Python and Node helper scripts.
Runs health checks for AppFlowy and GoTrue, including version mismatch warnings.
limitations: Targets AppFlowy Cloud 0.12.3 behavior and may need changes for other versions.
Requires valid credentials, tokens, workspace IDs, and view IDs supplied by the user.
Network calls use user-provided endpoints and can change AppFlowy content.
It does not manage AppFlowy permissions or recover deleted content.

use_cases.title: Validate a Self-Hosted Deployment
use_cases.description: Run AppFlowy and GoTrue health checks before using automation against a workspace.

use_cases.title: Build AppFlowy API Scripts
use_cases.description: Reuse authentication, request headers, and helper methods when creating custom workflow scripts.

use_cases.title: Update Structured Workspace Content
use_cases.description: Create pages, append blocks, and apply grid templates for repeatable project documents.

prompt_templates.title: Check My AppFlowy Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the appflowy-api skill to help me run a doctor check for my AppFlowy base URL and GoTrue URL. Explain each required value before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Get an Access Token
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the appflowy-api skill to authenticate with GoTrue using my supplied email and password. Show how to avoid exposing the token in logs.

prompt_templates.title: Search and Inspect Workspace Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the appflowy-api skill to search a workspace, list databases, and inspect row details for the identifiers I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Grid Template Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the appflowy-api skill to review a grid template, identify required workspace and view IDs, and apply it with a rollback plan.

output_examples.input: Run a doctor check against a configured AppFlowy deployment.
output_examples.output: A concise health report lists GoTrue, AppFlowy, workspace checks, and version mismatch warnings.

output_examples.input: Create a user management document from the included template.
output_examples.output: A completion summary names the workspace, parent view, new page, and block update result.

output_examples.input: Search a workspace for a project term.
output_examples.output: A readable result summary identifies matching AppFlowy content and the relevant workspace context.

best_practices: Use placeholders in shared configs and pass real endpoints through private local settings.
Run doctor checks before document or grid updates.
Use tokens with the least AppFlowy access needed for the task.
anti_patterns: Do not commit .env files, access tokens, or real private deployment URLs.
Do not run update scripts against production workspaces without a backup.
Do not paste credentials into prompts or logs.

faq.question: Does this skill need network access?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends requests to the AppFlowy and GoTrue endpoints that you configure.

faq.question: Does it read .env files automatically?
faq.answer: No. The scripts only read a .env file when you pass an explicit --env path.

faq.question: Which AppFlowy version is targeted?
faq.answer: The skill is documented for AppFlowy Cloud 0.12.3 and warns when the server version differs.

faq.question: Can it modify existing workspace data?
faq.answer: Yes. Several scripts create pages, append blocks, update grids, or delete generated grid rows.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it ready for production workspaces?
faq.answer: Use it first in a test workspace. Review endpoints, templates, and backups before production updates.
